locations.name: Delhi (National Capital)
locations.description: Historical monuments, Red Fort, Qutub Minar, and street food.

locations.name: Gurugram (Cyber City)
locations.description: Modern corporate hub with high-end shopping and dining like CyberHub.

locations.name: Alwar (Sariska & Forts)
locations.description: Ancient city featuring Sariska Tiger Reserve and Bhangarh ruins.

locations.name: Bharatpur (Bird Park)
locations.description: UNESCO World Heritage Keoladeo National Park, hosting rare birds.

locations.name: Agra (Taj Mahal City)
locations.description: Home of the iconic Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and exquisite Mughlai crafts.

locations.name: Mathura (Sacred Heritage)
locations.description: The divine birthplace of Lord Krishna on the Yamuna river ghats.

locations.name: Jaipur (The Pink City)
locations.description: Capital of Rajasthan, famous for Hawa Mahal, Amer Fort, and markets.

locations.name: Pushkar (Holy Town)
locations.description: Serene holy lake, rare Lord Brahma Temple, and camel desert fairs.

locations.name: Ajmer (Sufi Shrine)
locations.description: Home to the revered Khwaja Garib Nawaz Dargah and Ana Sagar Lake.

locations.name: Ranthambore (Tigers)
locations.description: Tiger Reserve offering majestic wildlife safaris and ancient fort.

locations.name: Bikaner (Desert Oasis)
locations.description: Junagarh Fort, Karni Mata (Rat) temple, and spicy Bikaneri bhujia.

locations.name: Jodhpur (The Blue City)
locations.description: Mehrangarh Fort overlooking blue houses, delicious traditional sweets.

locations.name: Jaisalmer (Golden City)
locations.description: Sandstone fort rising from Thar Desert, camel safaris, and sand dunes.

locations.name: Udaipur (City of Lakes)
locations.description: Romantic destination with grand Lake Palace floating on Lake Pichola.

locations.name: Chittorgarh (Fort of Valor)
locations.description: Massive hilltop fort, Vijay Stambha, and legends of Rajput bravery.

locations.name: Mandawa (Haveli Museum)
locations.description: Open-air art gallery famous for beautifully painted heritage Havelis.

locations.name: Mount Abu (Hill Station)
locations.description: Lush oasis in the Aravalli range, Nakki Lake, and Dilwara Temples.

locations.name: Kumbhalgarh (Great Wall)
locations.description: Massive fort featuring the second longest continuous wall in the world.

locations.name: Ranakpur (Jain Temples)
locations.description: Intricately carved 1444 marble pillars Jain Temple in Aravalli valleys.

locations.name: Kota (River Palaces)
locations.description: Lies on Chambal River banks, popular for palaces, gardens, and stone.

locations.name: Bundi (Stepwells City)
locations.description: Charming town with ornate stepwells, Taragarh Fort, and miniature art.

locations.name: Jhunjhunu (Shekhawati Capital)
locations.description: Grand Havelis, Rani Sati Temple, and rich brass arts.

locations.name: Jhalawar (Fort of Orchards)
locations.description: Unique fort, ancient sun temple, and orange orchards.

locations.name: Osian (Ancient Temples)
locations.description: Brahmanical and Jain temples dating from 8th to 12th centuries.

locations.name: Abhaneri (Stepwell Wonder)
locations.description: Famous Chand Baori stepwell, one of the deepest and largest in India.

locations.name: Fatehpur Sikri (Mughal Glory)
locations.description: Emperor Akbar's sandstone palace complex and towering Buland Darwaza.
